name: glass/macos-desktop
title: macOS Tahoe Liquid Glass Desktop (3D MacBook)
title_vi: Màn hình macOS kính lỏng trên MacBook 3D
desc_vi: MacBook 3D trên nền shader tối, màn hình là desktop macOS kiểu kính lỏng (thanh menu, widget lịch / thời tiết / nhạc, cửa sổ Finder, dock); thông báo tin nhắn trượt vào rồi nhún, máy quay lùi chậm, máy nghiêng nhẹ ba nhịp.
params_vi: wallpaper: ảnh nền desktop · app, menu, status: thanh menu · month, weekdays, city, temp, weather, hilo, playing, track: widget · window_title, sidebar {label, icon}, files {name, doc}: cửa sổ Finder · dock: danh sách biểu tượng · toast {icon, title, time, body}: thông báo · duration: độ dài chuyển động (15 s). Ảnh = icons/<tên>, wallpapers/<tên> trong assets của mẫu (ảnh gốc của nguồn) hoặc đường dẫn trong dự án.
notes: Faithful port of the source scene: three.js 0.147 renderer (ACES 1.15, sRGB), painted env map, shader backdrop, metal floor (0.9 / 0.2), lights, GLTF MacBook (scaled to 4.5 units, planar UVs on the 'display' mesh), camera pull-back cZ 4.5->7 / cY 0.4->0.6 over 0.5-12.5 s (cubic-bezier 0.45,0,0.15,1) looking at y -0.1, three breathing turns of the laptop (0->0.04->-0.03->0.02 rad, 1/5/9 s, 4 s each, cubic-bezier 0.37,0,0.63,1), ambient drift, the HTML desktop with the source's CSS and, over it, the source's canvas glass overlay (menu bar, widgets, Finder window, toast, dock) drawn by the same code; toast x 1464->988 (power3.out 0.38 s at 0.45) ->1002 (power2.out), opacity 0->1, bump y 62->72->62 at 4.25 s. Differences: (1) seek-safety: the source re-captured the HTML every frame with drawElementImage, which only returns the last PAINTED state, and its onUpdate render ran before same-time tl.set calls (a single seek in the kit showed no laptop at all). Here the desktop is captured once without and once with its HTML toast (window.__hf.buildReady waits), the static glass overlay is painted once, and per frame only the toasts are composed (the HTML toast is cut from the second capture at its rest box, slid and faded; its CSS shadow redrawn on canvas, so while it slides its frosted interior shows the backdrop of its rest position). State is computed from time. (2) Dead parts dropped: the iPhone canvas (iphone.glb is never loaded), hidden title/counter/card elements, the missing #mac-control/#mac-media handlers and their unused CSS. (3) The source's own artwork is used as shipped (HF registry, Apache-2.0): the Golden Gate wallpaper (assets/wallpapers/) and the app icons (assets/icons/: Finder, Safari, Mail, Calendar, Photos, Messages, Music, Brave, Slack, Files, toast icon; the dock/sidebar duplicates the source ships under two names are kept as shipped). Still changed: the Apple menu glyph (U+F8FF) is a small dot, and 'HyperFrames' / repo file names / San Francisco texts are Vietnamese params. Menu items are spaced by measured width (source: fixed 46 px, too tight for Vietnamese words); weekday labels are centred (two-letter 'CN'); the toast time is placed after the measured title. (4) Text uses the film's font (source: Inter). (5) three.js and GLTFLoader from engine/vendor, no DRACO decoder (macbook.glb is not Draco-compressed). (6) Kit runtime quirk handled: a fresh kit Chromium loses its first WebGL context ~0.15 s after creation and restores it ~1 s later; readiness waits 0.6 s plus any restore before capturing, the PMREM env map is rebuilt on restore. The 3D model assets/macbook.glb ships in the HF repo (Apache-2.0) but the model's own origin/licence is not verified. 05/10/2026: source artwork restored as default (user's decision).
